scope.chains: Use distinct moved knot pairs and moved shared distinctions. Their lift starts at one knot and ends at its mate. Distinctions within a single pair are recorded separately.
scope.lifts: Exhaustive knot involutions. For each, test the two extreme lifts within fixed owner sets, with one ordered bijection between distinct owner sets.
scope.states: Exact parity counts and not-all-equal existence. Small cases with up to ten distinctions are checked exhaustively under both laws. A null count means existence without a count.
scope.sampling: Archived cases and controls were chosen by construction. No weighting over starts was used.
scope.source_visibility: The archived rebuild preceded direct access to the study. An earlier terminology search surfaced summary lines from the assumptions register. The named comparison used the recorded rows and a separate implementation.
scope.late_rounds: Stages after round 2 were outside the state and swap analysis. A wider feasibility check reached the memory limit during the older engine's next-round group cross-check.
